sources: MDC GIS Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer/27 'Camping Sites' (12 Atlanta points) and /26 'Parking Lots' (9 Atlanta lots), queried 2026-11-09
Esri World Imagery frames: whole area (4.6 km), the pin lot, the central Jupiter Avenue junction and the east lake spot, viewed 2026-11-09
note: Oak-hickory uplands and bottomland woods in two tracts, the Atlanta tract plus the Corps-licensed Long Branch tract at the head of Long Branch Lake, with managed marshes, oxbows, ponds and a shooting range. The camping is a dozen single primitive spots spread along the area's gravel roads rather than a campground; the pin is the one at the gravel lot in the northeast corner. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites', 12 mapped single spots across the area, free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin is on a mapped spot at a gravel lot. No split: no group of spots is a distinct camping area. Not waterfront confirmed at the pin.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Individual Campsites' (and 'Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack'); the 1/26/2026 map shows about a dozen 'Camping site' symbols and GIS has 12 'Primitive Camping Area' points, each beside a gravel road or a GIS gravel lot (all lots Allows_Trailers 'No'). The stored pin (c0, 39.88967,-92.48558) sits in a ~40 x 25 m gravel turnaround lot (GIS lot 8 m away) at the end of a gravel road - drive-in for a 23-ft rig, no ford seen.

CLUSTERS (Atlanta asked for): the 12 points are SINGLETONS, not clusters - only five pairs sit within ~350 m of each other. By road: NE corner lot (c0, the pin); north along Justice Rd (c7 39.88682,-92.49575 and c8 39.88528,-92.50346, 680 m apart); NW (c9 39.8849,-92.51349); central Jupiter Avenue string, the road the area page's directions use (c6 39.8775,-92.50677, c5 39.87472,-92.50707, c1 39.86927,-92.50688 near the privy/ADA junction lot, c4 39.86514,-92.50946, c3 39.86221,-92.50994 - 6 spots within ~1.7 km incl. c10 39.87147,-92.5005); west (c11 39.87597,-92.52037); east lake by Hwy 63 (c2 39.87011,-92.48371). No split proposed: none of these is a distinct camping area of several sites, and all lie on one connected road net inside the area. The central Jupiter Avenue string is the nearest thing to a main cluster (2.2-3.7 km SW of the pin); the stored pin is a valid mapped spot on a clear gravel pad, so it can stay - moving it to c1 (central, 208 m from the junction lot with privy) is the alternative if a central pin is wanted.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed at the pin - no water at the NE lot. Lead only, not the pin: spot c2 on the east side sits in a small grassy opening ~45-50 m from a lake edge with the gravel ramp road between - at most a lakeview spot for that one site.
Note rewritten: generic MDC rules, the site-length line and the directions dropped.
